15 days · Marrakech → Marrakech

Mysterious Morocco

Transfer to the beautiful Ouzoud Falls with lunch, then a grand tour of the imperial cities, the desert and the coast.

Request a booking
15 days
Marrakech → Marrakech
Riads + desert camp
4x4 with guide
  1. Day1

    Marrakech

    Welcome at the airport and transfer to the riad, 2 minutes from the square.

  2. Day2

    Marrakech – Ouzoud Falls – Beni Mellal

    Transfer to the beautiful Ouzoud Falls (a splendid 100-metre waterfall). Lunch. Then the immense Bin el Ouidane lake in the magnificent setting of the High Atlas. Arrival at Afourer, a small town high in the mountains. We continue to Beni Mellal, among plantations of orange, olive, fig, pomegranate, apricot and peach trees, with stops to admire the impressive Middle Atlas landscape. Overnight in a riad.

  3. Day3

    Beni Mellal – Khenifra – Meknes – Fez

    Asphalt road to Meknes across the Middle Atlas; visit to the city (the tomb of Moulay Ismail, el-Hedim square, Bab Mansour) and on to the Roman ruins of Volubilis. A walk through the Roman city and arrival in Fez. Overnight in a riad.

  4. Day4

    Fez

    Visit to the city of Fez. Its architectural riches, fascinating medina and magnificent historical monuments make Fez the cultural capital of Morocco. Overnight in the same riad.

  5. Day5

    Fez – Ifrane – Azrou – Imilchil

    Across the Middle Atlas, visiting the "alpine" town of Ifrane and its impressive forest of century-old cedars with small monkeys, then into the foothills of the High Atlas to Imilchil, the village "of the Berber brides", famous because the girls of the Ait Hadiddou tribe choose their husbands. Overnight in a riad.

  6. Day6

    Imilchil – Amellago – Erfoud – Merzouga

    A day of real mountains, all by track, crossing the High Atlas, visiting century-old villages carved into the stone hillsides and the beautiful Amellago Gorge, finally reaching the Merzouga desert. Overnight at Riad Madu.

  7. Day7

    Merzouga – Erg Chebbi – Merzouga

    After breakfast, around the dunes by track: the two oases of Merzouga, the nomads in their tents, the village of Khamlia, the Mifiss mines, the desert plateaus and the Tissardmine oasis. In the afternoon we ride dromedaries into the dunes to watch the sunset and sleep in a wild oasis deep in the desert. A magical night under the tent.

  8. Day8

    Merzouga – Oubahlou – Alnif – Tinghir – Dades

    Another desert day with 150 km of track: beautiful landscapes, rivers of sand, small dunes, chotts, the ruins of the French fort of Oubahlou and villages where henna is grown, as far as Alnif. Lunch. Then the track over Jbel Ougnat towards Tinghir and the spectacular Todra Gorge, where kasbahs stand guard at the foot of the cliffs. Overnight in a riad.

  9. Day9

    Dades – Jebel Saghro – Zagora

    120 km of track and impressive lunar landscapes in Jebel Saghro, with rock pinnacles at 2,000 metres and oases in impossible canyons. A high-mountain route through this beautiful pre-desert region, down to the palm grove of the Draa river with its 150 km of palm trees. Overnight in a riad.

  10. Day10

    Zagora – Ouarzazate

    Visit to the Koranic library and the pottery workshops of Tamegroute; 60 km of track through the villages of the Draa valley via Agdz to Ouarzazate. Overnight in a riad.

  11. Day11

    Ouarzazate – Ait Benhaddou – Taroudant

    Visit to the famous kasbah of Ait Benhaddou, a World Heritage Site where films such as Alexander, Gladiator and Sahara were shot, and to the saffron fields of Taliouine, before reaching the fortified city of Taroudant behind its thick crenellated adobe walls. Overnight in a riad.

  12. Day12

    Taroudant – Agadir – Essaouira

    Through the argan mountains and the orchards of Agadir, then up the Atlantic beaches from Cape Rhir to the enigmatic Portuguese colonial city of Essaouira, with stops in lovely fishing villages. Overnight in a riad.

  13. Day13

    Essaouira – Marrakech

    Morning visit to the medina, lunch at the harbour and a walk along the beaches of Essaouira. Transfer to Marrakech. Overnight in a riad.

  14. Day14

    Marrakech

    Visit to Marrakech, the centre of Morocco, with its medina, colourful souks and the famous Jemaa el Fna square, lively day and night. Overnight in the same riad.

  15. Day15

    Transfer to the airport

    Breakfast and transfer to Marrakech airport.
